Netflix Releases Full Trailer for Jane Austen Adaptation

Netflix has released the full trailer for its upcoming limited series adaptation of Jane Austen’s classic novel, Pride and Prejudice. The six-part series is scheduled to premiere on the streaming platform on December 3.

The newly revealed footage opens with Emma Corrin’s Elizabeth Bennet and Freya Mavor’s Jane Bennet on a rooftop discussing their futures. The adaptation features a large ensemble cast, including Jack Lowden as Mr. Darcy, Olivia Colman as Mrs. Bennet, Rufus Sewell as Mr. Bennet, and Fiona Shaw as Lady Catherine de Bourgh. Additional cast members include Daryl McCormack as Mr. Bingley, Jamie Demetriou as Mr. Collins, and Rhea Norwood, Hopey Parish, and Hollie Avery as the remaining Bennet sisters.

Production Team and Creative Direction

The limited series is written by Dolly Alderton, known for Everything I Know About Love and Good Material, and directed by Euros Lyn, whose credits include Heartstopper. Executive producers on the project include Laura Lankester, Will Johnston, and Louise Mutter for Lookout Point, alongside Alderton and Lyn. Notably, lead actor Emma Corrin also serves as an executive producer, marking their debut in the role.
